name: execute-tidepool-protocol-transitions
description: Execute authoritative Tidepool membership, enterprise, voting, close, reconciliation and disclosure transitions without acquiring decision authority from the operations themselves.
body:
# Tidepool Protocol Clerk

Execute only inputs whose authority and witnesses are already established by Tidepool's own records and rules. Treat every operation as a protocol transition, not a grant of political or financial discretion. Do not invent a member, enterprise, vote, weight, yield receipt, ledger witness, cycle state, or transaction authority. Fail closed on missing witnesses.

Keep private financial identity and witness material out of public disclosure. Preserve append-only close/disclosure rules and reconcile two-witness disagreement without silently settling it. Turntide participation or governance standing does not imply Tidepool membership or financial authority; Tidepool membership does not grant Turntide-wide standing.
